item.hextale.unstable_hextech.tooltip: Hums and trembles. Lies in the centre of a rune's parchment.

rune.hextale.fire_water.effect: Turns water into steam and pushes with it.
rune.hextale.fire_water.use: Mechanism: a steam drive that moves pistons without redstone.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.effect: Heat turned on the earth: ore and sand melt by themselves.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.use: Pickaxe: ore drops as ingots, sand as glass.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.hint: Heat aimed at ore gives ingots by itself.
rune.hextale.fire_air.effect: Blows a cone of flame ahead.
rune.hextale.fire_air.use: Gauntlets: a jet of fire 5 blocks long.
rune.hextale.fire_light.effect: A fire that shines and never dies without fuel.
rune.hextale.fire_light.use: Mechanism: a lantern without fuel that lights the lanterns next to it.
rune.hextale.fire_light.hint: A flame that shines without wood, forever.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.effect: Burns only the creatures of darkness.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.use: Sword: double damage to the undead, burns cobwebs.
rune.hextale.fire_life.effect: Sets the living on fire at a touch.
rune.hextale.fire_life.use: Weapon: sets the target on fire on hit.
rune.hextale.fire_metal.effect: Melts an item back into metal.
rune.hextale.fire_metal.use: Mechanism: a smelter that returns ingots from broken tools.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.effect: Releases all the heat at once, like a blast.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.use: Drill: blasts the 3×3 blocks around the point of impact.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.hint: All the heat at once. Dangerous.
rune.hextale.water_fire.effect: Puts out fire, cools lava into stone.
rune.hextale.water_fire.use: Staff: puts out fires around, lava turns to obsidian.
rune.hextale.water_fire.hint: Water douses fire and cools lava.
rune.hextale.water_earth.use: Shovel: sand, gravel and dirt go in whole layers.
rune.hextale.water_air.use: Device: a cloud in which mobs lose their target.
rune.hextale.water_light.effect: Gathers light like a drop of water.
rune.hextale.water_light.use: Spyglass monocle: zooms in and highlights distant targets.
rune.hextale.water_shadow.use: Trap: mobs get stuck and slowly sink.
rune.hextale.water_life.use: Staff: heals creatures and players around.
rune.hextale.water_life.hint: Water washes wounds. Turn it on the living.
rune.hextale.water_metal.use: Weapon: ruins enemy armour, takes apart other people's mechanisms.
rune.hextale.water_spark.use: Mechanism: carries energy along a water channel.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.effect: Makes a thing harder and resistant to heat.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.use: Any tool: loses durability half as fast, does not burn in lava.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.hint: Stone does not fear fire. Could a tool?
rune.hextale.earth_water.use: Device: seals water and lava behind a wall.
rune.hextale.earth_water.hint: A wall of earth holds back even lava.
rune.hextale.earth_air.effect: Pulls everything that flies down to the ground.
rune.hextale.earth_air.use: Weapon: knocks down flying mobs, cancels knockback.
rune.hextale.earth_light.use: Pickaxe: a chance to get a gem or a hextech shard.
rune.hextale.earth_shadow.use: Mechanism: a hidden chest that looks like any other block.
rune.hextale.earth_life.use: Hoe: farmland never dries out, crops grow faster.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.effect: Leads excess charge into the ground.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.use: Mechanism: a lightning rod that protects machines from overload.
rune.hextale.air_fire.use: Mechanism: bellows, furnaces and smelters work twice as fast.
rune.hextale.air_water.use: Mechanism: a pump that drains and moves water and lava.
rune.hextale.air_water.hint: Wind drives the waves. Could it drive water?
rune.hextale.air_earth.use: Mechanism: a rune piston that moves up to 12 blocks.
rune.hextale.air_earth.hint: A gust moves dust. Why not a whole block?
rune.hextale.air_light.use: Device: an illusion that mobs attack.
rune.hextale.air_shadow.use: Boots: neither mobs nor sculk can hear the player.
rune.hextale.air_life.use: Helmet: breathing underwater, an air bubble.
rune.hextale.air_metal.use: Mechanism: a lift and a crane for blocks and entities.
rune.hextale.air_spark.effect: Catches the wind and turns it into charge.
rune.hextale.air_spark.use: Mechanism: a wind generator, stronger up high.
rune.hextale.air_spark.hint: Catch the wind and make it a charge.
rune.hextale.light_fire.effect: Gathers heat into a thin beam.
rune.hextale.light_fire.use: Cutter: cuts blocks along a line, a long-range shot.
rune.hextale.light_water.use: Flask: removes poisons and negative effects.
rune.hextale.light_earth.use: Goggles: ores and caves show through walls.
rune.hextale.light_earth.hint: Light sent into stone shows what hides.
rune.hextale.light_air.effect: Casts a beam into the sky.
rune.hextale.light_air.use: Beacon marker: seen from afar, links devices together.
rune.hextale.light_shadow.use: Device: hostile mobs do not spawn around it.
rune.hextale.light_life.use: Lamp: crops grow underground and at night.
rune.hextale.light_metal.use: Workbench: transfers runes onto tools and parts.
rune.hextale.light_spark.use: Mechanism: a light panel that works by day.
rune.hextale.shadow_fire.use: Mechanism: cools overheated machines, puts furnaces out.
rune.hextale.shadow_water.use: Device: drains water and lava around it.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.effect: Makes stone passable for a moment.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.use: Gauntlets: walk through a wall up to 2 blocks thick.
rune.hextale.shadow_air.hint: Shadow spilled into the air hides anyone.
rune.hextale.shadow_light.use: Device: darkness around it, torches go out.
rune.hextale.shadow_life.use: Weapon: part of the damage heals the wielder.
rune.hextale.shadow_metal.use: Weapon: enemy armour and tools break quickly.
rune.hextale.shadow_spark.use: Device: shuts down mechanisms around it.
rune.hextale.life_fire.use: Armour: immunity to fire and lava for a while.
rune.hextale.life_earth.effect: Grows things out of the soil.
rune.hextale.life_earth.use: Staff: trees and crops grow at once.
rune.hextale.life_earth.hint: Life from the soil: sprouts in a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.life_air.use: Mechanism: plants seeds around by itself.
rune.hextale.life_light.use: Arrows: highlight the target through walls.
rune.hextale.life_shadow.use: Weapon: passive and weak mobs fall asleep.
rune.hextale.life_metal.effect: Heals the lifeless as if it were alive.
rune.hextale.life_metal.hint: Life heals flesh. Could it mend steel?
rune.hextale.metal_fire.use: Mechanism: a rune furnace and smelter.
rune.hextale.metal_earth.hint: A chisel that bites into stone.
rune.hextale.metal_air.use: Mechanism: a fan that blows entities and items away.
rune.hextale.metal_shadow.use: Device: chests and doors open only with a rune key.
rune.hextale.metal_life.effect: Gives metal a semblance of life.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.use: Mechanism: an engine for every machine.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.hint: In metal, a charge starts turning wheels.
rune.hextale.spark_water.use: Trap: damages everyone in the water.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.effect: Strikes the ground with a discharge.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.use: Hammer: stuns everything around and crushes stone.
rune.hextale.spark_air.effect: Sends a discharge through the air.
rune.hextale.spark_air.hint: Lightning leaps from target to target.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.effect: Carries you through the shadow on a discharge.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.use: Gauntlets: a teleporting dash of 8 blocks.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.use: Mechanism: collects dropped items and ore.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.hint: Lightning loves iron. Let it pull iron.

gui.hextale.research_table.need.own_diar: This diary belongs to someone else. Bring your own.

item.hextale.essence_flask.mixture.hint: A mixture: split it in a Separator
gui.hextale.alembic.cold: Needs heat below: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
gui.hextale.separator.mix: Mixture: comes in through the inlets, or from a bottle
gui.hextale.separator.extract: Concentrate of the chosen essence: leaves through the concentrate outlets
gui.hextale.separator.unknown.hint: Filters the dark unknown essence out of a mixture; the rest comes out clean
gui.hextale.alembic.out: Leaves through a pipe on any side, or into glass bottles
gui.hextale.separator.rest: The rest of the mixture: leaves through the rest outlets
gui.hextale.slot.bottles: Glass bottles: the essence is bottled into them
gui.hextale.slot.alembic.input: An item to boil into essence. An unstudied one gives dark unknown essence
gui.hextale.slot.alembic.output: A filled bottle of essence comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.pour: A bottle of mixture to pour in
gui.hextale.slot.separator.extract: The bottled concentrate comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.rest: The bottled rest of the mixture comes out here
gui.hextale.research_table.ink.no_storag: No storage: place an Essence Jar of %s concentrate within 5 blocks of the table
gui.hextale.separator.ports.hint: The separator seen from above, its front towards you. Click a side to choose what its pipe does - or sneak-use that side of the block.
gui.hextale.port.inlet.hint: A pipe here brings the mixture in (green, arrow in)
gui.hextale.port.product.hint: The wanted product leaves here (blue, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.waste.hint: The by-product leaves here (rust, stopcock, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.none.hint: Nothing goes in or out here; no pipe joins it
gui.hextale.separator.vent.hint: The top lets out the gas of separation
item.hextale.essence_flask.unknown.hint: Unknown essence: the dark by-product of separation. It is no ink; pour it away through a Drain Valve, or filter it out of a mixture with a Separator
block.hextale.drain_valve.open: Valve open: what the pipes bring pours out
gui.hextale.alembic.water.hint: Each item boils in %s mB. Pipe water in from a Pump on any side, or pour a water bucket on the alembic
jei.hextale.boiling.heat: Heat under the alembic: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
jei.hextale.boiling.result: A mixture of the item's essences - study the item at the Research Table to know them
jei.hextale.info.alembic: Boils items into essence: studied ones into a mixture of their essences, unstudied ones into dark unknown essence. Set it over heat (fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma) and give it water: a bucket by hand or a pipe from a pump on any side. Every item takes 250 mB. The essence is poured into glass bottles or leaves through a pipe on any side.
jei.hextale.info.separator: Splits a mixture in two: choose on its screen which essence to draw out; it becomes a concentrate, burning blaze powder, and the rest goes on with a dark unknown essence added. The unknown essence can be chosen too: it is filtered out and the rest comes out clean. Choose in its screen - or by sneak-using a side - which side takes the mixture in and which lets the concentrate or the rest out. The top is a gas vent.
jei.hextale.info.essence_tank: A big glass jar with a wooden lid. Stores 256 mB of essence. Pipes fill it through the lid and the sides, it lets out at the bottom, and Separator inlets draw from it. Jars of concentrate within 5 blocks of a Research Table are its ink.
jei.hextale.info.brass_pipe: Carries essence and water between machines. It joins a machine only where the machine has a port; the machine shows the joint. Sneak + right-click a side with an empty hand: next to a pipe it shuts or opens the joint, next to a machine or jar it cycles both ways -> in only (green collar) -> out only (blue collar, pumps a jar out) -> shut (capped stub). Jars take essence through every face, the bottom too.
jei.hextale.info.pump: Place it in water: it pumps water up into a pipe on its top.
jei.hextale.info.drain_valve: Use it to open or shut the handwheel. Open, it pours out whatever the pipes at its sides bring. Essence poured onto stone soaks into it: every 16 mB turns one block where the stream lands into magic stone.
jei.hextale.info.research_table: The Research Table (two blocks). Studying items: an item in the study slot and paper - the prism shows its essences. Research: choose a device or tool in the book, lay down the diary, a hextech orb and paper, and draw the ink from the orb to every point of the parchment. The table draws its ink from jars of concentrate within 5 blocks. Read the finished research notes - and the item can be made.
jei.hextale.info.essence_flask: A glass bottle of essence. A bottle of a single essence is a concentrate - the Research Table's ink. A mixture is split in a Separator; what is left is an unknown essence.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.essence_flask: a bottle in the alembic's slot
commands.hextale.quests.reset: Reset the Researcher's Path quests of %s
quest.hextale.research_table.desc: Items are studied and devices researched here. The table takes two blocks. The "Research book" tab chooses what to research, the "Desk" tab is the work itself: diary, hextech, paper and parchment.
quest.hextale.brass.goal: melt Brass in the Hex Furnace
quest.hextale.brass.desc: Three copper and one zinc melt into four brass. Every tool of the researcher is made of brass: the table, pipes, the alembic and the separator. An ingot splits into nine nuggets and back.
quest.hextale.unstable_hextech.desc: Put a lightning rod on a block of amethyst and wait for a thunderstorm (a Channeling trident calls one too): the lightning shatters the amethyst into hextech orbs - and runs on through every amethyst block and cluster touching it, up to five blocks away. Budding amethyst carries the spark and stays whole.
quest.hextale.researchers_diary.desc: This is the book you are reading (right click): a book, an amethyst shard and a feather. Put it on the table - no research happens without it. The diary is signed with the name of whoever opens it first. Knowledge stays with you, not in the diary.
quest.hextale.item_study.desc: Put an item in the study slot and paper in the paper slot. Its essences hide in the prism's misty field: fire rays from the ports on the rim, watch where and in which colour they come out, and check the sections where essences lie. A studied item shows its essences in its tooltip.
quest.hextale.alembic.desc: Boils items in water into a mixture of their essences. An unstudied item gives only dark unknown essence. It needs fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma underneath. Every item takes 250 mB of water: pour a bucket in or pipe it from a pump.
quest.hextale.brass_pipe.desc: Carry essence and water between machines. A pipe joins a machine only at a port - a joint appears there. Sneak + right-click a side to shut it or choose its way.
quest.hextale.pump.desc: Place the pump in a water source - it pumps water up into a pipe. No more buckets for the alembic.
quest.hextale.essence_bottle.desc: Put glass bottles into the alembic - it fills them with the boiled mixture, 16 mB each. Bottles carry essence between machines by hand. A mixture is not ink yet: it holds all the item's essences at once.
quest.hextale.separator.desc: Splits a mixture in two. Choose on its screen which essence to draw out: it becomes a concentrate, burning blaze powder, everything else goes to the rest with a dark unknown essence. Choose the unknown essence itself to filter it out of a mixture: the rest then comes out clean. Choose what each side does - inlet, concentrate or rest - on the separator's screen or by sneak-using that side.
quest.hextale.drain_valve.desc: The separator's rest is not ink. Pipe it to the valve and open the handwheel: whatever arrives pours out - and essence that falls on stone soaks into it, turning it into magic stone.
quest.hextale.concentrate.desc: A concentrate is one pure essence - this is the ink. Choose the essence on the separator's screen and give it blaze powder.
quest.hextale.essence_tank.desc: Holds 256 mB. Takes essence in through the lid and the sides, lets it out at the bottom. Use a bottle on the jar to pour or fill. An Essence Sigil on it makes it take only that essence; sneak-use it with an empty hand to peel the sigil off.
quest.hextale.ink.goal: open the table with a jar of concentrate nearby
quest.hextale.ink.desc: The table draws its ink from jars of concentrate within 5 blocks. Research needs different essences - keep a jar of each. Research starts here: everything marked with an ink drop is researched at the table first - its step's plate has a "Research at the table" button. Drag the ink from the orb to every point with the mouse; right click takes a step back. Read the finished notes (right click).
goggles.hextale.network: In the vessels on this network:
quest.hextale.researchers_goggles.desc: Wear them on your head. Looking at a jar, a pipe or a machine shows the essences inside. Looking at a Research Table shows its ink, and coloured streams run from the jars to the orb.
research.hextale.burst: A curse! The orb burst and the parchment of %s burned with the ink spent on it. A fresh sheet holds a new board.
research.hextale.burnt: The parchment of %s burned. A fresh sheet holds a new board.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.empty: Put an item on the altar first
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing: The circle does not know what to do with this: check the pedestals, steles and jars
block.hextale.hextech_altar.busy: A ritual is running - sneak + use to abort it (what was drawn is lost)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.hint: Item in hand: put it on the altar. Sneak + empty hand: start the ritual
gui.hextale.stele.subtitle: Choose a rune for the circle
gui.hextale.stele.refuse.twice: Already on another stele of this circle
gui.hextale.stele.none: No rune does anything for the item on the altar.
gui.hextale.stele.unknown: A rune you have not learned yet
gui.hextale.stele.choose: Click: set it on the stele
book.hextale.quest.infusion.missing: The altar recipe is not loaded
quest.hextale.hextech_altar.desc: The heart of the ritual circle and of everything made from here on: the cutting discs, the pickaxes, the pylons and the sigils are born here. Put an item on the altar (right click), the ritual's items on pedestals within 6 blocks, choose runes on steles within 7 blocks and set Essence Jars within 8 blocks. Sneak + empty hand (or a redstone signal) starts the ritual: the altar's rings spin up, the items leave the pedestals one by one, then the jars give up their essences - and the result turns over the altar. Short of essence, the ritual waits; waiting too long ends in a blast. Ghosts over the pedestals show what is missing.
quest.hextale.pedestal.desc: Pedestals hold the ritual's items. Set up as many as needed, within 6 blocks of the altar and at most a block above or below it. During the ritual the items rise and fly into the altar one after another, round the circle. An extra item on a pedestal spoils the match: the altar marks it in red. Hoppers and pylons can lay items down by themselves.
quest.hextale.rune_stele.desc: A stele holds one of your runes with the stars you know it with. Steles within 7 blocks of the altar lend their runes to the ritual as beams of light: a pickaxe or a pylon alone on the altar takes the steles' runes in, and a blank scroll takes the rune of one stele. A stele offers only the runes that do something for the item on the altar.
quest.hextale.hextech_pickaxe.desc: An iron pickaxe charged with a hextech crystal. A good pickaxe by itself; its strength is in the runes it takes.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_altar: The heart of the ritual circle. Put the centre item on it, the ritual's items on pedestals within 6 blocks, choose runes on rune steles within 7 blocks; Essence Jars within 8 blocks feed it. Sneak + empty hand (or a redstone pulse) starts the ritual: first the pedestal items are drawn one by one, then the essences one after another.
jei.hextale.info.pedestal: Holds one item of an altar ritual. Up to 6 blocks from the altar, one block up or down; any number of them. Hoppers can fill it.
jei.hextale.info.rune_stele: Choose one of the runes you know on it. Within 7 blocks of a Hextech Altar it directs the ritual; steles are read clockwise from north.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.wait.item: The ritual waits: put %s back on its pedestal
gui.hextale.separator.choose.hint: Click: choose from all essences. Right click: clear. Wheel: next / previous
gui.hextale.separator.no_fuel.hint: One blaze powder draws 32 mB of the chosen essence
gui.hextale.slot.separator.fuel: Blaze powder: burned to draw the chosen essence out
item.hextale.unstable_hextech.volatile: Raw and volatile: a long fall or a blast makes it burst.
item.hextale.hextech_gemstone.tooltip: Stabilised: smooth and steady, the purest grade.
quest.hextale.hextech_gemstone.goal: finish a Hextech Gemstone on the lapidary
quest.hextale.hextech_gemstone.desc: The third grade: a cut crystal finished into a smooth, stabilised sphere. It never bursts and holds the most charge. The best tools and late devices are built around one.
quest.hextale.hextech_lamp.desc: A hextech crystal floating in a brass cage gives full light. It stands on the ground or hangs from a ceiling.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_lamp: A refined hextech gemstone floating in a brass cage: full light, never goes out. Stands on a block or hangs under one, like a lantern.
quest.hextale.magic_stone.desc: Stone drinks essence and keeps it. Soak eight stones around a bottle of any essence - or let a Drain Valve pour essence onto stone. Polish it, cut it into bricks: the ritual circle is built of them.
jei.hextale.info.magic_stone: Stone that has drunk essence. Craft eight stone, cobblestone, deepslate, tuff, andesite, diorite, granite or calcite around a bottle of any essence (the bottle comes back), or open a Drain Valve over such stone: every 16 mB of essence it pours turns one block where the stream lands into magic stone.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing.rune: The circle waits for runes on its steles: %s
book.hextale.quest.infusion.runes: Runes chosen on steles around the altar
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a pickaxe
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.clas: %s and %s are incompatible on one pickaxe
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a pickaxe holds four runes (a grindstone takes them off)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.noth: The pickaxe already carries these runes with as many stars
book.hextale.quest.pickaxe_rune.note: Up to %s runes on a pickaxe. A grindstone removes them all.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note: Pickaxe on the altar, rune on a stele. Up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.pickaxe_rune.goal: burn a rune into a hextech pickaxe
quest.hextale.pickaxe_rune.desc: Put the pickaxe alone on the altar, the rune on a stele beside it, and start the ritual. The rune is burned in like an enchantment and costs only essence. More stars, stronger rune.
quest.hextale.refined_pickaxe.desc: Diamond strength, hexsteel and two gemstones. Made from a hextech pickaxe, it keeps its runes and enchantments.
quest.hextale.radiant_pickaxe.desc: Netherite strength, fireproof. Infused from the refined pickaxe, it keeps its runes and enchantments.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.tempering.desc: Less wear, and hard stone breaks faster.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: Mines a whole ore vein. Sneak for one block.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.insight.desc: Right click: shows ores through stone.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The pickaxe's other runes get +1 ★ (up to ★★★★).
pickaxe_rune.hextale.drill.desc: Mines an area around the block. Sneak for one block.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.magnet.desc: Pulls items and experience to the holder.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.cache.desc: Drops go straight into the inventory.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.passage.desc: Right click: bores a tunnel ahead.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.quake.desc: Right click: shatters stone around, ores stay.
multiblock.hextale.big_essence_jar.forme: The Big Essence Jar wakes up
quest.hextale.big_essence_jar.goal: build a Big Essence Jar and wake it
quest.hextale.big_essence_jar.desc: Build it of blocks: a 3 x 3 floor of glass, two rings of glass around a hollow middle, a 3 x 3 lid of any wooden slabs. Then right-click it with unstable hextech or a hextech gemstone (the crystal is not used up). It holds as much as sixteen jars and works like one: bottles by hand, pipes join it anywhere, it pours out under its middle. Breaking any block takes it apart, and the essence inside is lost.
book.hextale.guide.wip_status: Work in progress: only a theory yet
book.hextale.guide.no_use: No use yet - this rune leads on to devices to come.
item.hextale.scroll_of_omniscience.desc: Right click: learn every rune with three stars, study every item, complete every quest.
item.hextale.scroll_of_oblivion.desc: Right click: forget all runes, studied items and quests.
subtitles.hextale.essence.draw: Essence is drawn from a jar
quest.hextale.wip_quench_tank.desc: A tank where red-hot tools are quenched in essence: tougher and longer-lasting.
quest.hextale.wip_rune_lock.desc: A chest or door that opens only for the one who set the rune.
quest.hextale.wip_drainer.desc: Drinks water and lava out of whole lakes, leaving a dry bed.
quest.hextale.wip_star_rod.desc: A tall hextech street lamp: lights far and pierces any smog.
quest.hextale.wip_beam_relay.desc: Mirrors passing a beam of light and power from block to block.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_cutter.desc: A beam that cuts blocks into stairs, slabs and patterns right in the world.
quest.hextale.wip_signal_beacon.desc: A beam into the sky seen from afar, and marks for friends.
quest.hextale.wip_mirage_projector.desc: Shows ghostly blocks and pictures - false walls and decorations.
quest.hextale.wip_rune_engraver.desc: Copies a learned rune onto a plate to share it.
quest.hextale.wip_flash_charge.desc: A charge that blinds everything around.
quest.hextale.wip_storm_collector.desc: Catches lightning and grows hextech without the risk of a blast.
quest.hextale.wip_crystal_battery.desc: Stores hextech energy for the machines to come.
quest.hextale.wip_wind_turbine.desc: Catches wind and storms to charge batteries.
quest.hextale.wip_levitation_plate.desc: Hextech's first experiment: whatever stands on it floats gently.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_lift.desc: A platform lifting players and loads.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_gate.desc: A pair of gates that carry you a short distance.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_turret.desc: Strikes enemies near your base with lightning.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_blade.desc: A weapon taking runes like the pickaxe: chain lightning, cleaving.
quest.hextale.wip_nullstone.desc: Drains stray magic around it and calms unstable rituals.
quest.hextale.wip_barrier_ward.desc: A dome that keeps out mobs and projectiles.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_flamethrower.desc: A hand flamethrower running on fiery essence.
quest.hextale.wip_mining_charge.desc: Blasts rock while leaving ores intact.
quest.hextale.wip_steam_boiler.desc: Turns water and heat into pressure for machines.
quest.hextale.wip_cooler.desc: Eats heat: cools machines and freezes water.
quest.hextale.wip_veil.desc: A cloak that makes its wearer invisible and silent.
quest.hextale.wip_rune_pump.desc: Pulls essence through pipes without water or pistons.
quest.hextale.wip_acid_bath.desc: Chemtech: dissolves ore into essence but poisons the ground around.
quest.hextale.wip_rune_anvil.desc: Repairs tools with essence, keeping runes and enchantments.
quest.hextale.wip_greenhouse.desc: Speeds up the growth of plants around it.
quest.hextale.wip_healing_spring.desc: Water that heals everyone who steps in.
quest.hextale.wip_respirator.desc: A mask against chemtech's poisonous smog.
quest.hextale.wip_purifier.desc: Burns away dark unknown essence and smog around it.
quest.hextale.wip_construct.desc: A small helper told by runes what to do.
quest.hextale.wip_shimmer.desc: A chemtech draught of great power - and heavy dependency.
quest.hextale.wip_hexcore.desc: A living matrix of runes around a crystal: the summit of research. Every rune learned brings you closer.
quest.hextale.wip_sap_tap.desc: A brass spout driven into a living trunk. Drop by drop it gathers sap essence into a hanging bottle - the first essence without boiling anything.
quest.hextale.wip_essence_sprinkler.desc: A turning brass head on a pipe sprays essence dew over the beds around it: water keeps the soil moist, sap makes crops grow faster. Glinting mist shows how far it reaches.
quest.hextale.wip_living_soil.desc: Farmland soaked in essence like magic stone: it never dries, is never trampled, and its crops grow a little faster. Pale veins glow under ripe plants.
quest.hextale.wip_field_ward.desc: A magic stone post with a hextech eye. Within its circle no monster appears and nobody tramples the beds.
quest.hextale.wip_tree_feller.desc: A hex saw on a magic stone stump. When the tree beside it is grown, the saw spins up and the whole tree comes down at once: logs, leaves and saplings go into storage.
quest.hextale.wip_seed_sower.desc: A clockwork brass bird on a perch. It hops over empty farmland and plants the seeds from the chest beneath it, drinking motion essence from the jars nearby.
quest.hextale.wip_reaper.desc: A slow wheel of brass sickles sweeps a ring of beds and cuts only what is ripe, leaving a seed behind. The harvest falls into the barrel below.
quest.hextale.wip_grove_keeper.desc: A lantern of living glass that plants saplings in a neat grid around itself and feeds them sap essence. With a Tree Feller - a forest that grows itself.
quest.hextale.wip_feeding_trough.desc: Feeds and breeds the animals around it from the food inside and stops once the pen is full. Life essence makes the young grow up faster.
quest.hextale.wip_geode_resonator.desc: A humming fork set into budding amethyst makes its crystals grow faster - more amethyst for raw hextech. Placed too close together, resonators crack the buds.
quest.hextale.wip_jar_gauge.desc: A brass dial fitted to a jar: its needle shows how full the jar is and gives a redstone signal, so machines can be switched by the level.
quest.hextale.wip_sawmill.desc: A spinning blade cuts logs into more planks than hands can, and into stairs, slabs and fences. The sawdust goes to the alembic as wood essence.
quest.hextale.wip_fish_weir.desc: A brass net lowered into open water. It fishes by itself, unhurried; water essence brings rarer catches.
quest.hextale.wip_compost_vat.desc: Takes plant waste and the dark unknown essence of the separator and rots them into bone meal and living soil. A use for waste instead of pouring it away.
quest.hextale.wip_the_gray.desc: Unknown essence poured out does not vanish: it turns into a heavy smog that creeps along the ground, dims crystals and sickens creatures. Every chemical works will have to deal with it.
quest.hextale.wip_chem_burner.desc: Chemtech's cheap heat: it burns the separator's unknown waste in an almost invisible green flame under an alembic or a smelter. It smokes - and the smoke has to go somewhere.
quest.hextale.wip_lab_bench.desc: Where chemtech is studied: a pipette, a rack of reagents and a dose log. A drop of essence on a plant or a creature acts with a delay - too little does nothing, too much kills.
quest.hextale.wip_experiment_pot.desc: A glass-capped pot for the Lab Bench. The plant inside takes doses, changes colour and shape, and the right dose turns it into a new species with new essences.
quest.hextale.wip_specimen_cage.desc: A brass cage for a live animal on the Lab Bench. Its pulse, heat and agitation show on the gauges; the wrong dose makes a hostile mutant.
quest.hextale.wip_rune_workbench.desc: Autocrafting the hextech way: lay a recipe out as glowing ghosts over the grid, and the bench crafts it from linked storage whenever the ingredients arrive. A drop of craft essence per item.
quest.hextale.wip_hextech_axe.desc: An axe with a gemstone heart and runes of its own: whole trees at one blow, logs straight into planks, saplings planted back.
quest.hextale.wip_hextech_hoe.desc: A hoe that tills a whole bed at once and reaps the ripe crops in one sweep, replanting as it goes. It takes runes of life.
quest.hextale.wip_sorting_matrix.desc: A floating lattice of lenses at the heart of a pylon network. It reads every item that passes and sends it where it belongs: ore to the smelter, seeds to the Sower, the rest to the chests.
quest.hextale.wip_xp_condenser.desc: Draws experience orbs into a glass coil and condenses them into knowledge essence - into jars, or back into bottles of experience.
quest.hextale.wip_ore_washer.desc: Washes raw ore in streams of water essence: three pieces for every two, and sludge of unknown essence left over.
quest.hextale.wip_herd_warden.desc: A post with a soothing gem. It shears, milks and gathers eggs from the animals in its pen and keeps their number steady.
quest.hextale.wip_spring_basin.desc: A magic stone basin that never runs dry: endless water for the sprinklers and the alembic.
quest.hextale.wip_bloom_censer.desc: A hanging censer that breathes pollen: flowers spread, saplings take root, bees work twice as hard.
quest.hextale.wip_magma_font.desc: Pours fire essence into a stone cauldron until the stone melts into lava. Costly - but the forge never cools.
quest.hextale.wip_rain_caller.desc: A mast of brass and glass that seeds the clouds with mist essence: rain over the fields - or a storm for the lightning rods.
quest.hextale.wip_essence_resonator.desc: Two jars tuned to each other share their essence without a single pipe, however far apart they stand.
quest.hextale.wip_world_anchor.desc: A heavy grounded weight that keeps the land around it awake while you are away: farms, saws and nodes go on working.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_bore.desc: A rune drill that sinks a square shaft down to the depths layer by layer, sends the ore into storage and leaves a ladder of light behind. It takes pickaxe runes.
quest.hextale.wip_shadow_coffer.desc: A pair of coffers sealed with one rune share one pocket in the shadow: what goes into one comes out of the other, anywhere in the world.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_archive.desc: Shelves of rune-sealed drawers hold thousands of items, all seen and taken from one floating index. The late answer to a hall full of chests.
quest.hextale.wip_folding_gate.desc: A small hexgate for things, not people: it folds space between two Courier Nodes, even in different worlds.
quest.hextale.wip_harvest_construct.desc: A brass helper with sickles for hands that walks the fields: it reaps, replants and carries the harvest to a Courier Node.
quest.hextale.wip_forester_construct.des: A tall construct that fells grown trees, plants new ones and keeps the grove in order.
quest.hextale.wip_winged_courier.desc: A small flying construct that carries items between storages where no beam reaches - over rivers, through caves.
quest.hextale.wip_crystal_vat.desc: Grows synthetic hextech crystals in a chemical bath: cheaper than storms, weaker than nature's - and the vat poisons the air around it.
quest.hextale.wip_glowbloom_bed.desc: Violet glowing flowers of the deep caves, tamed in a shaded bed. Their nectar is the first step towards shimmer.
quest.hextale.wip_regen_tank.desc: A tank where an axolotl's healing is drawn out drop by drop. It works - at a price the creature pays.
quest.hextale.wip_mutation_injector.desc: A chemtech needle that gives a creature a dose right in the world. The right mix makes it stronger and loyal; the wrong one makes a monster.
quest.hextale.wip_lull_lantern.desc: A dim lantern whose light lulls monsters and draws them into a chosen pen. A mob farm without cruelty - almost.
quest.hextale.wip_chrono_chamber.desc: A glass dome where time runs faster for whatever is inside: crops, furnaces, saplings. The faster it runs, the more the glass cracks.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.gathering: Gathers within %s blocks every %s s, %s at a time · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.sending: Sends %s items every %s s, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.relay: Passes items on, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.start: Right click a storage or a relay within %s blocks to link (%s/%s); a linked one to unlink; anywhere else to stop
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.far: Too far: %s blocks, the pylon reaches %s
pylon_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The pylon gathers wider and links farther.
pylon_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The pylon moves items more often.
pylon_rune.hextale.lift.desc: The pylon moves more items at once.
book.hextale.quest.pylon_rune.note: Up to %s runes in a pylon. A broken pylon keeps its runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_pylon: Pylon on the altar, rune on a stele. Up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a pylon
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a pylon holds three runes
quest.hextale.gathering_pylon.goal: make a Gathering Pylon at the altar
quest.hextale.gathering_pylon.desc: Instead of a clumsy mechanical arm - the pull of a hextech gem. Set on a chest, a barrel or a furnace, it reaches out with tendrils of light for the items lying around (6 blocks), drags them into its gem and lowers them into what it stands on - on a furnace, ore goes into the input and fuel into the fuel slot. With nothing under it, it sends them to its links. Runes widen its reach and quicken it.
quest.hextale.sending_pylon.goal: make a Sending Pylon at the altar
quest.hextale.sending_pylon.desc: Stands on a storage and sends what it gives out to the places you link. Right click the pylon, then right click where it should send. A chest or a barrel simply fills; a furnace sorts it itself - what it can cook into the input, fuel into the fuel slot. Up to four links, tried in order; sneak + right click the pylon with an empty hand to take them all away.
quest.hextale.relay_pylon.goal: make Relay Pylons at the altar
quest.hextale.relay_pylon.desc: Neither takes nor gives: a calcite column banded in copper, with an amethyst crystal resonating over it, catches whatever is sent to it - items or essence - and passes it on to its own links. Chains of relays carry them across the base.
quest.hextale.pylon_rune.goal: burn a rune into a pylon
quest.hextale.pylon_rune.desc: Put a pylon alone on the altar and choose a rune on a stele: Shift widens its reach, Motor quickens it, Lift moves more at once, Lens strengthens the others.
jei.hextale.info.gathering_pylon: Stands on a container and pulls items lying within its radius (6 blocks, more with Shift) into it through the top, nearest first. With no container under it, it sends them to its links. Right click with an empty hand: what it does now.
jei.hextale.info.sending_pylon: Stands on a container and sends what it gives out (what a hopper would take from below) to its links. Link: right click the pylon, then right click a container or a relay; the same again unlinks. A furnace gets what it cooks in its input and fuel in its fuel slot. Up to four links, tried in order. Sneak + right click with an empty hand takes all links away.
jei.hextale.info.relay_pylon: Passes items and essence sent to it on to its own links, at once. Relays chain up to eight.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.link: Right click, then right click a storage face or a relay: link
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.clear: Sneak + right click with an empty hand: take all links away
block.hextale.gathering_pylon.hint: Set on a container: pulls in the items lying around
block.hextale.sending_pylon.hint: Set on a container: sends what it holds to its links
block.hextale.relay_pylon.hint: Passes items and essence sent to it on to its links
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.untie: Sneak + right click a linked block with an empty hand: untie it
goggles.hextale.pylon.pace: Every %s s, %s items at a time
goggles.hextale.pylon.untie: Sneak + right click with an empty hand: untie
block.hextale.siphon_pylon.hint: Set on an Essence Jar: pours its essence to its links
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.siphon: Pours %s mB every %s s, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
goggles.hextale.pylon.pace_mb: Every %s s, %s mB at a time
quest.hextale.siphon_pylon.goal: make a Siphon Pylon at the altar
quest.hextale.siphon_pylon.desc: Pipes without pipes: set on an Essence Jar, it draws the essence up into its glass bulb and pours it as a stream of light to what you link - other jars, a separator, a big jar. Right click it, then right click where it should pour; relays pass the stream on.
jei.hextale.info.siphon_pylon: Stands on an Essence Jar and pours its essence to its links: jars, separators and anything else that takes essence from pipes. Link it like the other pylons (right click it, then the target); relays pass the essence on. Runes: Shift reach, Motor pace, Lift amount.
item.hextale.pylon_filter.hint: Right click: settings · on a pylon: set it in · sneak on a pylon: take it out
item.hextale.pylon_filter.not_here: A siphon carries essence: give it a sigil instead
item.hextale.essence_sticker.blank: Blank: right click to choose its essence
item.hextale.essence_sticker.hint: On a jar: it takes only this essence · on a siphon or relay: only this essence, pure, passes
item.hextale.essence_sticker.not_here: A sigil goes on a jar, a siphon or a relay
gui.hextale.sticker.title: Essence on the sigil
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.list: Only these: only the listed items pass. All but these: the listed items never pass. An empty sigil lets everything pass.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.exact: Kind: every stack of that item. Exact: only with the same enchantments, contents and damage.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.rule: Numbers (with "Only these"): keep N - a sending pylon leaves N of each item in its container; fill up to N - an item goes in only while the target holds fewer than N. Scroll over a slot to set N, with shift by ten.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.empty: Empty: everything passes. Put items into the slots.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.blackli: Everything passes except the items here.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.keep: Only these pass, and N of each stays behind.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.limit: Only these pass, each up to N in the target.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.slot.empty: Click with an item to put it here
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.slot.hint: Click: replace or clear · scroll: N (shift: by ten)
quest.hextale.pylon_filter.goal: make a Transfer Sigil at the altar
quest.hextale.pylon_filter.desc: Decides what a pylon picks up, sends or passes on: only some items or all but them, by kind or exactly, and with numbers - keep a stock in the chest, or fill a furnace only up to a stack. Right click it to set it up, right click a pylon to set it in.
quest.hextale.essence_sticker.goal: make Essence Sigils at the altar
quest.hextale.essence_sticker.desc: A hex sigil of one essence, written at the altar. A jar wearing it takes only that essence, pure. On a siphon or a relay it lets through only that essence, pure - pylons never split a mixture: that is the separator's work.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.no_load: Nothing here takes items or essence
item.hextale.research_notes.read: Use to read: then you can make it
item.hextale.research_notes.known: You have researched %s already. Hand the notes to another researcher.
item.hextale.research_notes.learned: Researched: %s. You can make it now.
research.hextale.locked: Research %s at the Research Table first
gui.hextale.research_table.researched: Researched already: this makes a copy of the notes
gui.hextale.research_table.burn.hint: Start this research over on a fresh sheet with a new board. The paper is lost, the orb and the ink stay.
gui.hextale.research_table.burn.confirm: Click again to burn the parchment
gui.hextale.research_table.goal.hint: Reach it with the ink; a step onto it costs %s of its essence
gui.hextale.research_table.corner.hint: Every step towards this corner is paid with it
book.hextale.runes.title: Runes found: %s
book.hextale.runes.none: You have not found any rune yet. Runes are kept on scrolls in chests: dungeons, temples, mineshafts and buried treasure hold simple runes, strongholds, mansions and the Nether harder ones, ancient cities, end cities and bastion treasure the rarest. How many stars a found scroll carries is luck.
gui.hextale.stele.refuse.one_scroll: A scroll takes one rune: clear the rune on the other stele
block.hextale.hextech_altar.write.one_ru: To copy a rune you need a blank scroll on the altar, one rune on one stele and empty pedestals
quest.hextale.rune_scroll.goal: find a rune scroll and read it
quest.hextale.rune_scroll.desc: Runes are not invented - they are found. Rune scrolls lie in the chests of dungeons, temples, mineshafts, strongholds and ancient cities: the deeper and more dangerous the place, the harder the rune. A scroll's stars are luck. Read the scroll (right click) and the rune is yours: every rune found is on the "Runes" tab.
quest.hextale.blank_scroll.desc: Three sheets of paper rolled up. A rune you know can be copied onto it - and handed to a friend.
quest.hextale.written_scroll.goal: copy a rune onto a scroll
quest.hextale.written_scroll.desc: Put a blank scroll on the altar, choose a rune on one stele and leave the pedestals empty. The altar draws the rune's essence once per star and writes the scroll with your stars. This is how knowledge passes from researcher to researcher.
jei.hextale.info.blank_scroll: A blank scroll of three sheets of paper. Put it on the altar, choose a rune you know on one stele and start the ritual: the altar writes a scroll of that rune with your stars.
jei.hextale.info.rune_scroll: Runes are found in chests: dungeons, temples, mineshafts, buried treasure - simple ones; strongholds, mansions, the Nether, trial vaults - harder ones; ancient cities, end cities, bastion treasure - the rarest. A scroll's stars are random. A scroll of a rune you know can be copied onto a blank scroll at the altar.
jei.hextale.info.research_notes: The notes of a finished research from the Research Table. Read them (right click) and the item can be made. The notes can be handed to another player.
item.hextale.unstable_hextech.throw: Throw it and it shatters into hextech dust.
item.hextale.hextech_dust.tooltip: Glitters and tingles. Wakes the tools it is sprinkled on.
item.hextale.hextech_crystal.tooltip: Cut along its seams. It holds its charge and no longer bursts.
block.hextale.crucible.say.items_full: The water holds no more kinds of things
block.hextale.crucible.say.not_a_bucket: Not enough water for a bucket
block.hextale.crucible.say.full: There is no room for more water
block.hextale.crucible.say.not_boiling: Only boiling water takes things in - heat it from below and wait
block.hextale.crucible.say.no_water: The crucible is dry: pour in a water bucket or water bottles
block.hextale.crucible.status.cold: %s - water %s mB. Light a fire, a campfire, magma or lava under it
gui.hextale.hex_workbench.no_charge: Not enough charge: put a hextech crystal into the socket
gui.hextale.hex_workbench.charge.hint: Hextech in the socket soaks into the bench as charge (raw %s, crystal %s, gemstone %s, up to %s); every craft spends some.
gui.hextale.slot.hex_workbench.crystal: A hextech crystal: its charge powers the crafts
gui.hextale.hex_furnace.fuel.hint: Anything that burns in a furnace.
gui.hextale.hex_furnace.locked: This alloy must be researched first
gui.hextale.slot.hex_furnace.input: A metal for the alloy: up to three different ones
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.no_crystal: Put a crystal into the clamp
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.wrong_disc: A crystal is finished only on a master disc
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.heat.hint: Grinding heats the crystal, resting cools it. At the top it cracks.
gui.hextale.slot.hex_lapidary.input: Raw hextech, or a hextech crystal to finish
gui.hextale.slot.hex_lapidary.output: The cut stone (or dust, if it shattered)
quest.hextale.hextech_dust.desc: Raw hextech cannot take a blow: throw an orb (right click) and it shatters into glittering dust where it lands. Orbs that burst in a fall or a blast leave dust too.
quest.hextale.hex_workbench.desc: Sprinkle hextech dust on a crafting table (right click): the dust sinks in and the table wakes as a Hex Workbench. Almost every device is made on it. Each craft spends a little charge, which the hextech crystal in its socket gives.
quest.hextale.crucible.desc: Sprinkle hextech dust on a cauldron: it wakes as a Crucible. Fill it with water and light a fire under it. Once the water boils, it takes in essence from bottles and jars and dissolves the things dropped into it. What it brews of them is yet to be found.
quest.hextale.hex_furnace.desc: Sprinkle hextech dust on a furnace: it wakes as a Hex Furnace that melts up to three metals together into an alloy on ordinary fuel. New alloys must be researched before it melts them.
quest.hextale.sphalerite.desc: Zinc ore: a dull brown-grey stone with honey-coloured grains. It lies in stone and deepslate like copper, a little rarer, from deep underground up to sea level.
quest.hextale.zinc.desc: Raw zinc smelts into ingots in any furnace. Nine ingots make a block, an ingot splits into nine nuggets.
quest.hextale.hex_lapidary.desc: Raw hextech splits cleanly only along its hidden cleavage planes. Clamp an orb over the disc, turn it until the contact line glows green and grind - in short strokes, the heat cracks it. Too many cracks and it falls to dust. The cutting disc is made at the altar.
quest.hextale.hextech_crystal.desc: The second grade of hextech: cut along its seams, it holds a charge and no longer bursts. Most devices are built around one; on the workbench it gives more charge than a raw orb.
quest.hextale.hexsteel.desc: Iron melted with coal and hextech dust: a dark blue steel that takes an edge no other metal holds. The better hextech tools are forged from it.
quest.hextale.master_cutting_disc.desc: A hexsteel disc edged with diamond. Only it finishes a hextech crystal into a stabilised gemstone - the finer cut has more planes and less room for error. It also cuts raw orbs twice as fast.
quest.hextale.wip_magic_metal.desc: Hexsteel answers the hand, but not yet the rune. Somewhere between the furnace and the gemstone lies a metal that remembers the magic poured into it. How it is made is still being worked out.
jei.hextale.info.hex_furnace: A furnace woken with hextech dust. Melts up to three metals together into an alloy on ordinary fuel: three copper and a zinc make four brass; iron, two hextech dust and coal make hexsteel (researched). Hoppers fill the metals from the top and the fuel from the sides, and take the alloy from below.
jei.hextale.info.crucible: A cauldron woken with hextech dust (a water cauldron keeps its water). Pour in a water bucket or water bottles and heat it from below: fire or a campfire heats it, soul fire faster, lava fastest. Only boiling water takes things in - bottles and jars of essence pour into it, items thrown over it or put in by hand are drawn in, sink and dissolve. It holds 1500 mB: water, essence and 30 mB for each dissolved item; more spills over the rim. Boiling water evaporates. An empty bucket takes the water back out with everything in it; sneak-use with an empty hand boils it all away in a cloud of steam.
jei.hextale.info.hex_workbench: A crafting table woken with hextech dust. Almost every device is crafted on it, and each craft spends charge from the hextech crystal in its socket: raw hextech gives 5, a hextech crystal 12, a gemstone 30. Devices that need research show nothing until they are researched.
jei.hextale.info.hex_lapidary: Cuts raw hextech into hextech crystals (any cutting disc) and finishes crystals into stabilised gemstones (master disc). Turn the crystal until the contact line glows green and grind it in short strokes; grinding across the planes or overheating cracks it, and too many cracks shatter it into dust.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_dust: Throw raw hextech (right click) and it shatters into 2-3 dust where it lands; an orb bursting in a fall or a blast leaves 2 per orb. Sprinkled on a crafting table or a furnace (right click), dust wakes it into a Hex Workbench or a Hex Furnace.
jei.hextale.working.lightning: Lightning on the rod shatters the amethyst - and every amethyst touching it.
jei.hextale.working.throw: Thrown (right click), the orb shatters into 2-3 dust.
jei.hextale.working.awaken: Sprinkle the dust on the block (right click).
jei.hextale.working.cut: Cut along the cleavage planes on the Hex Lapidary.
jei.hextale.working.finish: Finished on the Hex Lapidary with a master disc.
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.turn: Turn the crystal (wheel or A/D) until the band glows green
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.aligned: Green! Hold the mouse or space to grind
